qualification.details: For all nine Assistant Professor posts, the notice states the eligibility only as "As per norms of AICTE / Anna University". Robotics and Artificial Intelligence post, the notice states that M.E. / M.Tech. candidates in these areas are encouraged: | Robotics and Automation Robotics and Mechatronics Mechatronics Engineering Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering Instrumentation and Control Engineering Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Other relevant interdisciplinary specializations | Candidates should check the official notification and the AICTE / Anna University norms it refers to for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Applications are sent by email. The notice gives these steps:
Download the application form from www.cit.edu.in/announcements. The form, "Application for the Post of Assistant Professor", and a data sheet are also printed in the notice PDF.
Fill in the application form and affix a recent passport size photograph in the space given.
Fill in the data sheet with the post and department applied for.
Sign the declaration with place and date.
Send your resume and the filled-in application form to [email protected] before 04.12.2026.
Department and area of specialization, full name in capital letters (as in SSLC certificate), date of birth and age, citizenship status, community
Communication address with email and mobile, permanent home address, and name and address of parent or spouse
University education from X standard onwards (degree, discipline, university, division, percentage, year of passing) and professional experience in chronological order with basic pay and scale of pay
Course materials, monographs and books, consultancy work through the institution and summer/continuing education programmes during the last three years, membership of professional bodies

Papers in international and national journals (SCI / WoS / Peer reviewed) during the last five years, conference papers, innovations in teaching/evaluation, programmes organised and sponsored research during the last three years
Distinctions and awards, visits abroad, present basic pay, minimum basic pay expected, time required to join if the post is offered, and three references (preferably of professional background)

The data sheet asks for name and address, nationality, age and date of birth, UG and PG degrees, Ph.D. (year, university, specialization), post-doctoral specialization, present position with salary, teaching (UG/PG), research (pre- and post-Ph.D.) and industrial experience in years, the number of journal and conference publications, Ph.D. theses and M.Tech./M.S. projects guided, books authored and sponsored research projects.
important_instructions: By the declaration in the form, if any information is later found incorrect or false, or the candidate does not satisfy the eligibility criteria, the candidature or appointment is liable to be cancelled or terminated. The name must be written as in the SSLC certificate. The notice is signed by the Principal, Coimbatore Institute of Technology.

content_sections.heading: About CIT
content_sections.text: Coimbatore Institute of Technology is an institute located at Civil Aerodrome, Coimbatore – 641 014, with its website at www.cit.edu.in . The recruitment notice is issued under the name of the Principal and covers faculty posts for its engineering, integrated M.Sc., Mathematics and B.Tech. Robotics and Artificial Intelligence programmes.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following Assistant Professor openings. It does not print the number of posts for any of them.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: For all nine Assistant Professor posts, the notice states the eligibility only as "As per norms of AICTE / Anna University". It does not print a separate degree, percentage or experience requirement for any post. For the B.Tech. Robotics and Artificial Intelligence post, the notice states that M.E. / M.Tech. candidates in these areas are encouraged: Robotics and Automation Robotics and Mechatronics Mechatronics Engineering Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering Instrumentation and Control Engineering Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Other relevant interdisciplinary specializations Candidates should check the official notification and the AICTE / Anna University norms it refers to for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CIT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are sent by email. The notice gives these steps: Download the application form from www.cit.edu.in/announcements . The form, "Application for the Post of Assistant Professor", and a data sheet are also printed in the notice PDF. Fill in the application form and affix a recent passport size photograph in the space given. Fill in the data sheet with the post and department applied for. Sign the declaration with place and date. Send your resume and the filled-in application form to [email protected] before 04.12.2026 .

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Resume Filled-in application form with a recent passport size photograph affixed Attested copy of the community certificate Attested copies of degrees/diplomas and certificates/experience certificates Reprints/Xerox copies of papers published in journals/conferences Data sheet filled by the candidate

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: By the declaration in the form, if any information is later found incorrect or false, or the candidate does not satisfy the eligibility criteria, the candidature or appointment is liable to be cancelled or terminated. The name must be written as in the SSLC certificate. The notice is signed by the Principal, Coimbatore Institute of Technology.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for CIT Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The resume and filled-in application form must be emailed before 04.12.2026 (4 December 2026).

faq.question: Q2. In which specializations is CIT recruiting Assistant Professors?
faq.answer: CIT is recruiting in Computer Science & Engineering (Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence), Integrated M.Sc. Programmes (Software Systems, Data Science, Decision & Computing Sciences, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Industrial Mathematics and Quantum Computing), Mathematics and B.Tech. Robotics and Artificial Intelligence.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for CIT Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The eligibility is as per the norms of AICTE / Anna University for all the posts.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for CIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the application form from www.cit.edu.in/announcements, fill it in, and email it with your resume to [email protected] before 04.12.2026.

faq.question: Q5. To which email address should the application be sent?
Q6. Which documents must be enclosed with the CIT application?
faq.answer: Enclose attested copies of degrees/diplomas, certificates and experience certificates, reprints/Xerox copies of published papers, an attested community certificate, and affix a recent passport size photograph.

faq.question: Q7. Can M.E. / M.Tech. candidates apply for the B.Tech. Robotics and Artificial Intelligence post?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice encourages M.E. / M.Tech. candidates in Robotics and Automation, Robotics and Mechatronics, Mechatronics Engineering, Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering, Instrumentation and Control Engineering, Artificial Intelligence and Robotics and other relevant interdisciplinary specializations.

faq.question: Q8. What happens if information in the CIT application is found false?
faq.answer: The candidature or appointment is liable to be cancelled or terminated if any information is found incorrect or false, or if the candidate does not satisfy the eligibility criteria.
